missions.title: GHOST SIGNAL
missions.subtitle: Intercept an Imperial transmission before it reaches the fleet
missions.briefing:
An Imperial comm relay is broadcasting on an open frequency. The signal contains fleet coordinates but it is encrypted.

Find datatape DT-07, decrypt it at a terminal, then deliver to R5-D4.

steps.title: Locate Datatape DT-07
steps.description: Search the outpost for the intercepted transmission tape

steps.title: Decrypt at Terminal
steps.description: Insert datatape into the Imperial comm relay terminal

steps.title: Deliver Intel to R5-D4
steps.description: Return decoded coordinates to the rebel droid

missions.title: DEAD DROP
missions.subtitle: Recover a concealed intel package from the outpost
missions.briefing:
A rebel operative left a datacard hidden in the eastern corridor. Retrieve it before Imperial patrols find it.

Bring it to R5-D4 for decoding.

steps.title: Retrieve Dead Drop
steps.description: Locate the concealed datacard near the eastern corridor

steps.title: Deliver to Contact
steps.description: Find the rebel droid and hand off the intel

missions.title: SHADOW PROTOCOL
missions.subtitle: Execute a classified extraction operation
missions.briefing:
High command has authorized a shadow extraction. This operation requires accessing classified materials and uploading them off-site.

This mission is dangerous. Proceed with caution.

steps.title: Access Classified Tape
steps.description: Acquire the shadow-encrypted datatape from the secure vault

steps.title: Extract via Terminal
steps.description: Use any Imperial terminal to upload extracted data

steps.title: Signal Extraction
steps.description: Scan the extraction chip to confirm mission complete
